error[MBS-E8]: `sample` reads a texture in a vertex shader, which the 3DS can't do
  --> e08_sample_in_vertex.mbs:28:17
   |
28 |     output.color = sample(tex, input.uv)
   |                    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ texture read in the vertex stage
   |
   = note: it is used in `vertex_main`, and the PICA200 vertex unit can't read textures
   = help: sample in `fragment_main`, pass the data in a uniform, or put the lookup in a `when TARGET != .PICA200` branch
   = more: docs/shader_errors.md#mbs-e8

mbsc: e08_sample_in_vertex.mbs: 1 error(s)
